answer: A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The velvet schedule is applied in karst and inlet shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 38% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1118 identities would post 3339 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
